exercises.title: A Package Collection
exercises.script: Your package has arrived at the service desk. Please bring photo identification when you collect it. The desk closes at six, but packages can be collected tomorrow morning from eight-thirty.
exercises.question: What must the customer bring?
exercises.explanation: The customer must bring photo identification.

exercises.title: A Team Update
exercises.script: We have completed the survey and organized the responses. Next, we will prepare a short summary for the director. After receiving comments, we will revise the report and share the final version with the whole team.
exercises.question: What will happen after the summary is prepared?
options: The team will organize the responses.
The final version will be shared immediately.
exercises.explanation: The team will receive comments after preparing the summary, then revise the report.

exercises.title: A Revised Recommendation
exercises.script: At first, I supported opening the facility every evening. After reviewing the staffing data, I think a three-evening schedule would be more realistic. It would still improve access without placing excessive pressure on the team.
exercises.question: What position does the speaker finally support?
exercises.explanation: The speaker changes from every evening to a more realistic three-evening schedule.
